title.ar: نجاح تنظيم فعاليات العيد وسط حضور جماهيري كبير

text.en: 20,000+ visitors across the Eid days, with full setup, crowd management and continuous entertainment programming.

text.en: The beginning that shaped Mood Event's philosophy of experience and execution.
